summary: Smoke-tested imported GiftsDates app (React + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 8/8 pytest smoke tests passing (meta, admin login, /auth/me, register+login flow, invalid credentials guard, profiles listing via /api/users, date-ideas). Frontend: landing page renders original luxury design, /auth login works for admin (giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345), redirects to /browse, Browse page lists seeded TEST profiles, Profile page loads with form fields populated, no page/console errors. All backend API calls returned 200 (auth/me, meta, notifications, spin/status, videocalls/incoming, vip/schedule/pending-count).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~several thousand lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into routers (auth, profiles, dates, wallet, admin) for maintainability.
Email/SMS integrations (Twilio, EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY) are not configured in env — notifications silently become 'not_configured'; expected per request but worth flagging.
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set to placeholder 'sk_test_emergent' — payments will fail if exercised; out of smoke-test scope.
Login endpoint lowercases email at storage; UI should display email in a canonical casing to avoid user confusion (minor).
test_credentials: Admin: giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345 (works). New-user signup via /api/auth/register also works.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_user_* accounts were created via pytest smoke runs; visible in Browse. Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smoke scope only. Deeper flows (likes/matches, gifts, Stripe checkout, video calls, dates escrow, admin panel actions, ID verification uploads) were NOT exercised. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_smoke.py and run via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public_url> pytest backend/tests/test_smoke.py` from /app. Admin password is Admin@12345.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found during smoke testing.
